annotations.title: Federal MDL dockets by actions pending

description: Federal multidistrict litigation (MDL) dockets from the Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation's monthly pending-dockets reports, largest first: the docket number, title, court district, actions pending on the report date, total actions, and the change over the past year. Filter by words in the title (for example "hair relaxer" or "talcum") or ask for one docket (MDL-2738) to get its monthly history since 2019. Counts are court actions, not people. Paginated with cursor. Results summarize public sources for marketing planning; they are not legal advice.
